div.head: II Cn 43
div.ab: Gyf gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaðscylde, gewylde hine man ⁊ healde to bisceopes dome, be þam þe seo dæd si.
Gyf gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaðscylde, gewylde man hine ⁊ healde to ðæs bisceopes dome, be ðam ðe seo dæd sy.
Gif hadod man hine forwyrce mid deaðscylde, gewylde man hine ⁊ healde to byscopes dome, be þam syo dæde sy.
Si quis ordinatus se forisfaciat in morte plectendis actibus, capiatur et seruetur episcopi iudicio discutiendus, secundum quod factum sit.
[43] Si ordinatus se forisfaciat crimine mortali, superetur et ad episcopi iudicium custodiatur iuxta facti qualitatem.
Gyf gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaðscylde, gewylde man hine ⁊ healde to ðæs bisceopes dome, be ðam ðe seo dæd sy.
Gyf gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaðscylde, gewylde hine man and healde to bisceopes dome, be þam þe seo dæd si.
Wenn ein geweihter Mann sich [sein Leben] verwirkt durch Todes [würdige] Schuld, ergreife und bewahre man ihn für des Bischofs Urtheilsspruch, je nachdem die Missethat ist..
If a man in orders forfeits himself by a capital offence, let him be seized and held for the bishop's judgment, according to what the deed is.
If a man in holy orders places his life in jeopardy by committing a capital crime, he shall be arrested, and his case shall be reserved for the bishop's decision, according to the nature of the deed.
If a man in holy orders commits a capital crime, he is to be seized and kept for the bishop’s judgment, according to the nature of the deed.
If a person in orders compromises himself with a capital crime, he is to be arrested and held for the bishop’s judgment, according to the nature of the offense.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl geistliches Gericht 9g. Statt ‘Urteil’ berichtige ich o. II 757 die Übs.: ‘Entscheidung über die Strafe’. Die Todeswürdigkeit ist vom Urteil weltlichen Gerichts festgestellt; die moralische Schwere und die wirkliche Strafe bestimmt der Bischof.—Der Nachsatz ‘je nach Tat’, oft bei Cnut wiederholt (u. 45, 2), kann aus VIII Atr 34 oder EGu 2 entnommen sein; er will der rein formalen Beurteilung entgegenwirken zugunsten moralisch-psychologischer

Cf. Gl geistliches Gericht 9g. For ‘judgement’ I correct the translation above II 757 to: ‘decision on the penalty’. That he has deserved death is established by the judgement of the secular court; the moral gravity and the actual penalty are determined by the bishop. — The clause ‘according to the deed’, often repeated by Cnut (below 45, 2), may be taken from VIII Atr 34 or EGu 2; it seeks to counteract purely formal assessment in favour of a moral and psychological one
